3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The specter of the recent naval incident cast a long shadow over our relations. I sensed it in the mood of everyone around me.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the expressionless faces of the Palesian delegation with no sight of the Duke himself.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Our convoy drove steadily across the cobbled streets of Old Town Pales. It was my second visit to the Palesian capital since becoming King of Rizia, and the atmosphere this time was far more tense.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: The specter of the recent border incident cast a long shadow over our relations. I sensed it in the mood of everyone around me.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: No pleasantries were exchanged and no diplomatic gestures were played to the cameras. We were instead quickly ushered inside as the reporters were blocked off.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: Nobody from my security detail nor the welcoming delegation spoke as we entered the room where the meeting was to take place.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: When Duke Reinhart entered the room, everyone else left. He didn't speak a word until we were completely alone.

14.speaker: Axel Reinhart
14.text: "King Romus. Your rushed arrival here is a testament to the gravity of our situation."

15.speaker: Axel Reinhart
15.text: "I wish I could say your visit today brings me comfort, but under these circumstances, I find it hard to extend a warm welcome."
15.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Border_KillSoldiers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true) == false

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: He extended his hand for a handshake.

19.speaker: Axel Reinhart
19.text: "You're not even going to bother, eh?"

20.speaker: Axel Reinhart
20.text: "You dare to attack my people, then fail to show respect to me in the very heart of our land."

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: He stared at me, brow furrowed.

25.speaker: Axel Reinhart
25.text: "Look. I do not intend to allow Pales be pushed around by Rizia any longer."

26.speaker: Axel Reinhart
26.text: "So please. Listen to me very carefully..."

27.speaker: Axel Reinhart
27.text: "If you think I'd let Rizia use an orchestrated incident as justification for, well...

28.speaker: Axel Reinhart
28.text: "...Whatever you intend to do. You'd be wrong."

29.speaker: Axel Reinhart
29.text: "Despite the AN ruling in your favor, you went and deployed your navy to the field -- completely going against the resolution."
29.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_CedeCancelled"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship_DeployedAfterAN"] == true)

30.speaker: Axel Reinhart
30.text: "Is this not a declaration of war? What dialogue could you possibly be after?"

34.speaker: Axel Reinhart
34.text: "You not only cancelled your deal at the last minute, you went against international law by deploying your navy and blockading Aureus. And now you sank a Palesian ship."

35.speaker: Axel Reinhart
35.text: "Please help me understand, *Your Majesty.* Because I'm having a devil of a time making sense of your actions right now."

36.speaker: Axel Reinhart
36.text: "What right does the Rizian Navy have to block our access to the field? You not only went against international law, you sank a Palesian ship."

40.speaker: Axel Reinhart
40.text: "Despite the AN ruling against you, you went and deployed your navy to the field -- in direct violation of the resolution."
40.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_CedeCancelled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship_DeployedAfterAN"] == true)

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "Orchestrated incident? It was your soldiers that went inside and occupied a fort."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "Hold on a second. According to our reports, your soldiers shot first. And I seem to believe those reports."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "Believe me, I'm on the same boat as you. Our reports suggest that your soldiers shot first. I came here to get some answers."

47.speaker: Axel Reinhart
47.text: "Looking for answers? After you kill every single one of them?"

51.speaker: Axel Reinhart
51.text: "So you decided to kill every single one of them before verifying any of your reports?"

55.speaker: Axel Reinhart
55.text: "And it was the Rizian Army that killed every single one of them."

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "Not at all. I am merely stating our stance, Your Grace."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "I hope we can sort this problem out today, Your Grace."

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "No. I'm not going to let you dictate anything. You're going to listen to me now."

67.speaker: Axel Reinhart
67.text: "Despite the AN ruling in your favor, you insisted on maintaining your blockade of the field -- completely going against the resolution."
67.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_CedeCancelled"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship_DeployedAfterAN"] == true) == false)

71.speaker: Axel Reinhart
71.text: "Despite the AN ruling against you, you insisted on maintaining your blockade of the field -- in direct violation of the resolution."
71.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_CedeCancelled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship_DeployedAfterAN"] == true) == false)

72.speaker: Axel Reinhart
72.text: "Rizia has no right to block access to Aureus, Your Majesty. This is an open attack against Pales and international law."

73.speaker: Axel Reinhart
73.text: "Is this not a declaration of war? What dialogue could you possibly be after?"

74.speaker: Axel Reinhart
74.text: "Please help me understand, *Your Majesty.* Because I'm having a devil of a time making sense of your actions right now."

75.speaker: Axel Reinhart
75.text: "We know that your soldiers incited the incident. Our guards moved to the islet during the firefight -- simply because they were under fire."

76.speaker: Axel Reinhart
76.text: "And you're going to claim we shot first?"

77.speaker: Axel Reinhart
77.text: "So please tell me, Your Majesty. What in the hell happened at Navar Castle?"

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "The deal wasn't in the best interests of the Rizian people. We will cede our rights no longer. Your ships have to respect our claims."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Rizia is laying claim to the entirety of the Aureus field. And frankly, I don't think Pales can do anything about it."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "Let's not start on the wrong foot, Your Grace. I am aware of the incident, and I am here for peace."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "We will not recognize the biased and unjustified resolution of the AN. Lespia and their western sponsors manipulated the ruling."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "Let's get our facts straight, Your Grace. Your ships were warned but they not only ignored them, our flagship was rammed into."

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: He looked at me, discomfort and concern etched onto his handsome features.

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "The deal wasn't in the best interests of the Rizian people. We will cede our rights no longer. Your ships have to respect our claims."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "I have decided to take the entirety of the Aureus field. And frankly, I don't think Pales can do anything about it."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "Let's not start on the wrong foot, Your Grace. I am aware of the incident, and I am here for peace."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "We will not recognize the biased and unjustified resolution of the AN. Lespia and their western sponsors manipulated the ruling."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "Your ships were warned. Not only did they ignore that warning, they rammed into our flagship. Did you give the order yourself?"

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "We believe that this was an orchestrated incident to incite instability. I am not sure who is behind this, but our reports suggest it was the Palesians who shot first."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "Let's not start on the wrong foot, Your Grace. I am aware of the incident, and I am here for peace."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Your soldiers went inside Rizia and occupied a fort. Is this not an act of war, Your Grace?"

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "There is a lot of misinformation going about. There are conflicting reports on which side shot first. I came here to get some answers."

102.speaker: Axel Reinhart
102.text: "Rizia has no right to do that, Your Majesty. This is an open attack against Pales and international law."

103.speaker: Axel Reinhart
103.text: "Peace? You are directly responsible for sinking our ship."

104.speaker: Axel Reinhart
104.text: "Peace? You are directly responsible for sinking our ship and the loss of Palesian lives."

112.speaker: Axel Reinhart
112.text: "Rizia has no right to block access to that field, Your Majesty. This is an open attack against Pales and international law."

113.speaker: Axel Reinhart
113.text: "Look at what you are saying, Your Majesty. The ruling was manipulated because you don't like the outcome?"

115.speaker: Axel Reinhart
115.text: "We are not the side who fired at you."

116.speaker: Axel Reinhart
116.text: "I refuse to even respond to that question, Your Majesty."

122.speaker: Axel Reinhart
122.text: "Rizia is directly responsible for sinking our ship."

123.speaker: Axel Reinhart
123.text: "Rizia is directly responsible for sinking our ship and the loss of Palesian lives."

124.speaker: Axel Reinhart
124.text: "So tell me, Your Majesty. What is the stance of your kingdom? What are you trying to achieve here?"

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "It's true, it was my decision to blockade the field. But the incident wouldn't have happened if your ship didn't ram into us. The damage it inflicted was extensive."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "It was an accident, Your Grace. Rizia, by no means, wanted to escalate the tensions. The admirals reacted on their own."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "Our stance is clear. Aureus lies inside our borders and anyone who enters that territory is subject to Rizian law."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "We are all deeply saddened by the incident. I'd like to offer our sympathies and apologies on behalf of our kingdom."

129.speaker: Axel Reinhart
129.text: "The international community acknowledged your claim and rewarded you half of the entire field. What more do you want?"

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "It was an accident, Your Grace. Rizia, by no means, wanted to escalate the tensions. The admirals reacted on their own."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "We are all deeply saddened by the incident. I'd like to offer sympathies and apologies on behalf of our kingdom."

132.speaker: Axel Reinhart
132.text: "I refuse to accept your comments. Don't mock me, Your Majesty."

133.speaker: Axel Reinhart
133.text: "You just told me about your intentions of not letting go of Aureus. You gave the order to blockade the field."

137.speaker: Axel Reinhart
137.text: "You just told me about your intentions of not respecting the AN's resolution. You gave the order to blockade the field."

138.speaker: Axel Reinhart
138.text: "You may regard Pales as an insignificant appendage of your own kingdom -- but you have not seen our reach in the world yet."

139.speaker: Axel Reinhart
139.text: "You are pushing me into a corner. And I have decided not to allow Rizia push us around any longer."

140.speaker: Axel Reinhart
140.text: "I see that, Your Majesty. It is a stance of aggression and war."

141.speaker: Axel Reinhart
141.text: "No. I will not allow Rizia to threaten Pales like this, Your Majesty."

143.speaker: Axel Reinhart
143.text: "Are you not going to accept any responsibility?"

144.speaker: Axel Reinhart
144.text: "Don't expect me to believe that was an accident."

148.speaker: Axel Reinhart
148.text: "You allowed our sailors to die in the sea and captured our vessels, Your Majesty."

149.speaker: Axel Reinhart
149.text: "Don't expect me to believe you are saddened by any of this."

153.speaker: Axel Reinhart
153.text: "You allowed our sailors to die in the sea and captured our vessels, Your Majesty."

154.speaker: Axel Reinhart
154.text: "I find it difficult to believe, Your Majesty."

155.speaker: Axel Reinhart
155.text: "Is this going to be Rizia's official stance then?"

157.speaker: Axel Reinhart
157.text: "But Pales is expecting more than an apology."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "Yes. And we are all deeply saddened by the incident. I'd like to offer our sympathies and apologies on behalf of our kingdom."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: He had no expression on his face.

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "I hope to decide that after today's meeting."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "Our stance is clear. Aureus lies inside our borders and anyone who enters that territory is subject to Rizian law."

162.speaker: Axel Reinhart
162.text: "Are you not going to accept any responsibility?"

163.speaker: Axel Reinhart
163.text: "Rizia had better have something to offer, Your Majesty. It is not you who will dictate this conversation."

164.speaker: Axel Reinhart
164.text: "Oh, please. Then why did you capture our ships? Was that also in the name of humanitarian aid?"

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "We did our best to save your officers, but we couldn't reach them in time."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "We had to focus our aid on our flagship that was damaged almost beyond repair. There were hundreds of people on that ship, Your Grace."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "What do you want me to offer you? I am willing to do what it takes to preserve peace between our countries."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Of course not. Your ship rammed into our vessel and sank. Rizia has nothing to do with this."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "Not for retaliating for your attack against our flagship. Pales is the one that escalated the incident."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "I will. However, Pales must understand and respect Rizia's stance on Aureus."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "We will not accept responsibility for retaliating for your attack against our flagship. Pales is the one that escalated the incident."

172.speaker: Axel Reinhart
172.text: "I understand. Rizian lives seem to matter more, after all..."

175.speaker: Axel Reinhart
175.text: "We will stand alone if need be. But we will not bow down to your harassment any longer."

176.speaker: Axel Reinhart
176.text: "Then I have nothing else to say. Except this."

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: Suddenly he bursted out in hysterical laughter.

178.speaker: Axel Reinhart
178.text: "I didn't expect you to come up with such nonsense."

179.speaker: Axel Reinhart
179.text: "And why did you capture our ships again? Was that also an *unintentional* consequence?"

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "Nobody wants a war, Your Grace. I am here to reach a mutual understanding with you."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "Now you seem to be threatening me. And I don't like where this is going."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "Perhaps we can still reach an agreement. But Pales must understand and respect Rizia's stance on Aureus."

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: He looked annoyed when I disrupted him.

188.speaker: Axel Reinhart
188.text: "She is safe and sound, Your Majesty. Don't worry."

189.speaker: Axel Reinhart
189.text: "We'll bring her in later. But first, you will listen to me."

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "There's nothing else I can offer you."

195.speaker: Axel Reinhart
195.text: "These are not the actions of a country that wants peace. Wouldn't you say?"

199.speaker: Axel Reinhart
199.text: "You allowed our sailors to die in the sea and captured our vessels, Your Majesty."

200.speaker: Axel Reinhart
200.text: "You'd better have something to offer other than an apology, Your Majesty."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "You have to trust me, Your Grace."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "I assure you, we want peace. But if you keep pushing us, we are ready for anything."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "We don't need to be enemies. Please understand the predicament I'm in. I cannot let go of that field so easily."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "Let's not start on the wrong foot, Your Grace. I am aware of the incident, and I am here for peace."

208.speaker: Axel Reinhart
208.text: "Looking for answers? After you kill every single one of them?"

215.speaker: Axel Reinhart
215.text: "So you decided to kill every single one of them before verifying any of those reports?"

216.speaker: Axel Reinhart
216.text: "And it was the Rizian Army that killed every single one of them."

218.speaker: Axel Reinhart
218.text: "You may not have falsified the reports yourself, Your Majesty. But obfuscation is afoot."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "No. I'm only here to take my daughter home to Rizia."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Don't worry, Your Grace. As long as Vina and I can leave Pales in peace, there will be no such aggression from us."

234.speaker: Axel Reinhart
234.text: "You claim you want peace after the Rizian Army killed every single Palesian involved?"

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "Regardless of who shot first, your soldiers went inside Rizia and occupied a castle in the process. So please, don't try to blame Rizia."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "I'd like to know the same, Duke Reinhart. The incident at our border is deeply regrettable, and I assure you, Rizia seeks a peaceful resolution."

237.speaker: Axel Reinhart
237.text: "You claim peace and you're still making threats?"

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "Nobody wants a war, Your Grace. I am here to reach a mutual understanding with you."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "Do you think Pales can stand against Rizia?"

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: "You've made your point, Your Grace. I don't intend to pursue any aggression. Rizia only wants peace. I just need Vina to come back with me."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "Enough of this. Do you want reconciliation or not?"

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "It doesn't matter now, Your Grace. The fact is that is now part of the negotiations, whether you like it or not."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "We did not capture anything. Your sailors will be released after the vessels are fully inspected."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "There are consequences for rash actions, Your Grace. They ignored our warnings and rammed into our ship. I don't think I need to repeat this."

251.speaker: Axel Reinhart
251.text: "Rizia will no longer dictate anything, Your Majesty."

252.speaker: Axel Reinhart
252.text: "Exactly, Your Majesty. There are consequences for rash actions."

253.speaker: Axel Reinhart
253.text: "And your actions are leading us to war."

254.speaker: Axel Reinhart
254.text: "Either you will listen to our demands and back off from Aureus completely..."

255.speaker: Axel Reinhart
255.text: "It sounds like they're being held captive to me."

256.speaker: Axel Reinhart
256.text: "I have nothing left to say. Except this."

257.speaker: Axel Reinhart
257.text: "I don't think you want to find that out, Your Majesty."

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "You're wrong. I intend to find out."

259.speaker: Narrator
259.text: He paused for a moment. His face darkened.

265.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
265.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Border_KillSoldiers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true) == false

266.speaker: Axel Reinhart
266.text: "I wish I could say your visit today brings me comfort, but under these circumstances, I find it hard to extend a warm greeting. But still... Welcome back."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "The reports we received can be deceptive, and I fear we are both victims of a larger game. It is not my desire, nor the desire of Rizia, to escalate tensions. We seek only to defend our sovereignty, as you do yours."

269.speaker: Axel Reinhart
269.text: "Peaceful resolution? When Rizian troops are shooting at our borders, and reports of aggression filter through every channel?"

270.speaker: Axel Reinhart
270.text: "Defend your sovereignty? Or expand it at the cost of ours? Reports suggest it was Rizian soldiers who fired first, instigating the conflict."

271.speaker: Axel Reinhart
271.text: "You must understand how this appears from my perspective."

272.speaker: Axel Reinhart
272.text: "You killed our soldiers at the castle and ignore the reason how everything started?"

276.speaker: Axel Reinhart
276.text: "I am to believe Rizian reports? When Rizian troops are shooting at our borders, and reports of aggression filter through every channel?"

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "Appearances can be deceptive, and I fear we are both victims of a larger game. It is not my desire, nor the desire of Rizia, to escalate tensions. We seek only to defend our sovereignty, as you do yours."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "I understand. But I must assure you. I am here with peaceful intentions, Your Grace."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "How about my perspective? I was told it was your soldiers who initiated a firefight and occupied a castle inside Rizia. We are only defending our sovereignty."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "Those reports are not accurate, Duke Reinhart. Rizia has no interest in provoking a war. The situation at the border was a defensive response, triggered by movements we perceived as hostile."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "And why would I believe the Palesian reports?"

282.speaker: Axel Reinhart
282.text: "Perceived as hostile? So, we are to believe this was all a misunderstanding? A tragic error in judgment that cost lives?"

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "Let's get our facts straight, Your Grace. Our reports suggest otherwise. You can't claim to be the source of the truth."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "What would we gain from this, Your Grace?"

286.speaker: Axel Reinhart
286.text: "You know the same goes for me, Your Majesty."

288.speaker: Axel Reinhart
288.text: "Look, Your Majesty. You speak of peace and cooperation, yet the actions at the border tell a different story."

292.speaker: Axel Reinhart
292.text: "Your soldiers surrounded and killed every Palesian in the castle without hesitation. You didn't think about communicating with me then."

293.speaker: Axel Reinhart
293.text: "So, how can I trust the words of a king whose armies take impulsive actions and stand ready to march into my lands?"

294.speaker: Axel Reinhart
294.text: "At this very moment, our soldiers in that castle are surrounded by your forces."

295.speaker: Axel Reinhart
295.text: "If you want to have a dialogue, they must first be allowed to leave."

296.speaker: Player_Romus
296.text: "It was interpreted as an occupation by the army and they responded accordingly. I cannot fault my soldiers for protecting our borders."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "Duke Reinhart, the positioning of our troops is purely defensive. The real question is, why were Palesian forces so close to the border in a manner that could be interpreted as provocative?"

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "Impulsive actions? The real question is, why did Palesian forces decide to enter a paleacci inside our borders and stay there?"

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "I am filled with regret about this whole thing. I am here to listen to your concerns. You have to trust me, Your Grace."

300.speaker: Axel Reinhart
300.text: "They were caught in the open when your forces opened fire, Your Majesty. They only took refuge there."

301.speaker: Axel Reinhart
301.text: "Provocative? It is common for patrols to be near borders. It is another thing entirely to respond with gunfire. Do you suggest we do not have the right to secure our own borders?"

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "Of course you have a right to secure your borders. Just the same way as we do."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "Securing borders is one thing, Duke, but reports indicate an aggressive stance from your patrols. We must consider the possibility of miscommunication among our forces, perhaps even deliberate misinformation."

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "I'm not saying that, Your Grace. The real question is, why did Palesian forces decide to enter a paleacci inside our borders and stay there?"

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "Refuge? They did not surrender when they were surrounded, Your Grace. They were not the victims here. They killed six of our soldiers."

311.speaker: Axel Reinhart
311.text: "Perceived as hostile? So, we are to believe this was all a misunderstanding?"

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "Of course. They will be allowed to leave immediately."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "Well... That depends on the outcome of our meeting, doesn't it?"

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "I'm afraid that cannot happen. They need to surrender to us, and at the very least, stand trial for their actions against Rizian people."

315.speaker: Axel Reinhart
315.text: "I want to trust you but Rizian actions make it very difficult."

316.speaker: Axel Reinhart
316.text: "Miscommunication? You speak as if the incident was a mere diplomatic faux pas. Lives were lost, Your Majesty."

317.speaker: Axel Reinhart
317.text: "This cannot be brushed aside as a misunderstanding."

318.speaker: Axel Reinhart
318.text: "Rizia responded disproportionately harsh, Your Majesty. Wouldn't you say so?"

319.speaker: Axel Reinhart
319.text: "We were in close cooperation since we agreed on our deal on Aureus."

320.speaker: Axel Reinhart
320.text: "Why would Rizia act in this manner, right before the deal is finalized?"

321.speaker: Player_Romus
321.text: "Your reports say one thing, Duke, but ours indicate an aggressive stance from your patrols. We must consider the possibility of miscommunication among our forces, perhaps even deliberate misinformation."

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "It looks like a very deliberate choice, Your Grace. Pales is the land of *paleaccis.* Was that a coincidence your forces occupied one?"

323.speaker: Axel Reinhart
323.text: "Are you claiming Pales wants to invade and occupy Rizia?"

324.speaker: Axel Reinhart
324.text: "Nobody would believe that, Your Majesty. And you know you also don't."

325.speaker: Axel Reinhart
325.text: "Do you really believe I am after a ruined medieval castle?"

326.speaker: Player_Romus
326.text: "I'm not brushing anything aside. I suspect it could be an inside job."

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: "I do not and I never would underestimate the gravity of the situation, Your Grace. But we must not let this tragedy set the course for our nations."

328.speaker: Player_Romus
328.text: "Are you going to threaten me, Your Grace? I'm doing my best to reach an understanding but you are constantly pointing fingers."

330.speaker: Axel Reinhart
330.text: "A noble sentiment, but how do I reconcile it with the reports from my commanders? They claim your forces were not just defending, but actively pursuing engagement."

332.speaker: Axel Reinhart
332.text: "You cannot threaten Pales any longer, Your Majesty. I will not bow down to your threats. Palesians interpret this as an act of war."

333.speaker: Axel Reinhart
333.text: "If you do not release them, it is proof that Rizia was after aggression all along and this incident was all a ruse to justify war."

336.speaker: Axel Reinhart
336.text: "Now... It is common for patrols to be near borders. It is another thing entirely to respond with gunfire."

337.speaker: Axel Reinhart
337.text: "We were in close cooperation since we agreed on our deal on Aureus. And right before the signing... This happens."

338.speaker: Axel Reinhart
338.text: "And how do I reconcile it with the reports from my commanders? They claim your forces were not just defending, but actively pursuing engagement."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "And yet, my reports suggest the exact opposite. That it was your forces who seemed to be edging closer to a conflict. We won't reach anywhere like this."

340.speaker: Player_Romus
340.text: "This disparity in reports is precisely why a joint investigation is critical. We cannot rely solely on biased perspectives."

341.speaker: Axel Reinhart
341.text: "This cannot be brushed aside as a misunderstanding."

342.speaker: Player_Romus
342.text: "I'm not brushing anything aside. I suspect it could be an inside job."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "I do not and I never would underestimate the gravity of the situation, Your Grace. But we must not let this tragedy set the course for our nations."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "Are you going to threaten me, Your Grace? I'm doing my best to reach an understanding but you are constantly pointing fingers."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "What would we gain from this, Your Grace? This happened right before the signing of our deal. This is definitely intended to sabotage our claims on Aureus."

346.speaker: Axel Reinhart
346.text: "Biased perspective? Are you suggesting that Pales is fabricating its reports?"

348.speaker: Axel Reinhart
348.text: "We cannot rely on biased perspective of the Rizian forces. There is clearly a mismatch between our reports."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "Are you suggesting that Rizia is fabricating its reports?"

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "I agree. And there's nothing we would gain from this. This happened right before the signing of our deal. This is definitely intended to sabotage our claims on Aureus."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "I suspect it could be an inside job."

353.speaker: Axel Reinhart
353.text: "So, you also think that your reports are untrustworthy?"

354.speaker: Axel Reinhart
354.text: "This cannot be brushed aside as a misunderstanding."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "Not fabricating, Your Grace, but there is always a lens through which situations are viewed. Each side sees the other's actions through a filter of suspicion and defense. Our goal should be to remove these filters and seek the objective truth."

357.speaker: Player_Romus
357.text: "No. I'm not pointing fingers at Pales. It could be from within Rizia as well."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "It is a possibility. How can either of us be certain?"

359.speaker: Axel Reinhart
359.text: "Not at all. But it is a possibility."

360.speaker: Axel Reinhart
360.text: "The 'objective truth' is a slippery concept, Your Majesty. What is true for Rizia may not be true for Pales."

361.speaker: Axel Reinhart
361.text: "Looking for certainty is a slippery slope, Your Majesty. What is true for Rizia may not be true for Pales."

362.speaker: Axel Reinhart
362.text: "Confusion and paranoia. This perspective is a slippery slope, Your Majesty."

363.speaker: Axel Reinhart
363.text: "Your call for a joint investigation seems more like a tactic to buy time, perhaps to strengthen your position."

364.speaker: Axel Reinhart
364.text: "I'm merely pointing out the biases Rizians have."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "I suppose it could be an inside job."

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "Each side has a bias, Your Grace, we don't have a monopoly over it. Our goal should be to remove these filters and seek the objective truth. A joint investigation may be necessary."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "No. I won't allow you to point fingers at Rizia. It could be from within Pales as well. Your side would be giving away their rights to the field, after all."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "I don't want to believe that but it is a possibility."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "They are as trustworthy as the Palesian reports."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "Of course. As soon as Vina leaves Pales with me."

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "They will be released. As soon as Vina leaves Pales with me."

381.speaker: Axel Reinhart
381.text: "You are the side that initiated the attack, Your Majesty."

382.speaker: Axel Reinhart
382.text: "If you are not willing to listen to Palesian demands, we will interpret this as an attack on our country."

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "On the contrary, Duke Reinhart. Delay benefits neither of us. The longer this tension persists, the greater the risk of escalation."

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "Your Grace, we need to act swiftly and decisively to prevent a conflict that would be catastrophic for both our nations."

386.speaker: Axel Reinhart
386.text: "Catastrophic, indeed. But can you assure me that this investigation will not be swayed by the powers at play?"

387.speaker: Axel Reinhart
387.text: "There is great risk, indeed. But can you assure me that this investigation will not be swayed by the powers at play?"

388.speaker: Axel Reinhart
388.text: "Neutral international observers must be involved for it to be a proper investigation."

389.speaker: Player_Romus
389.text: "I don't think either of us can assure that, Your Grace."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "I propose we involve neutral international observers in the investigation. Let them be our eyes and ears, free from the biases of our national interests."

391.speaker: Player_Romus
391.text: "Regardless of the investigation, Rizia wants to continue with our previous deal and preserve peace with Pales. Can you assure me if it's a possibility?"

392.speaker: Axel Reinhart
392.text: "I agree. That could be a way to ensure the investigation is not swayed by either side."

394.speaker: Player_Romus
394.text: "That would work, Your Grace. However, their findings must be accepted by both Rizia and Pales, without question."

395.speaker: Axel Reinhart
395.text: "Rizia will no longer dictate anything, Your Majesty."

396.speaker: Axel Reinhart
396.text: "Then you have to prove it, Your Majesty."

398.speaker: Axel Reinhart
398.text: "Are you going to listen to our concerns, or not?"

399.speaker: Player_Romus
399.text: "Yes. And I deeply regret what happened."

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "No, Your Grace. You are making a mistake with your harsh attitude. I'm done listening to you."

407.speaker: Axel Reinhart
407.text: "...Or... Well... Let's not even imagine that scenario."

408.speaker: Narrator
408.text: He paused for a moment. His face darkened.

411.speaker: Axel Reinhart
411.text: "Then you won't be surprised to hear that the Palesian Navy has been deployed to the Aureus."

412.speaker: Axel Reinhart
412.text: "We will not bow down against your aggression any longer. Rizia will have no access whatsoever to any energy from the Antacean Sea."

413.speaker: Player_Romus
413.text: "That would be a cause for war."

414.speaker: Player_Romus
414.text: "You cannot afford to keep your navy at the field at all times, Your Grace."

415.speaker: Player_Romus
415.text: "You intended to escalate the situation further, after all..."

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: "I will let the world know about your stance. Let's see who they'll support."

417.speaker: Axel Reinhart
417.text: "You seem confident despite Rizia's clear breach of international law."

418.speaker: Axel Reinhart
418.text: "Your attack was the cause for everything, Your Majesty, and you know that."

419.speaker: Axel Reinhart
419.text: "Oh, you don't know our new capabilities, Your Majesty."

420.speaker: Axel Reinhart
420.text: "You seem confident... As if we were the side that broke their promise and cancelled a deal at the last minute."

421.speaker: Axel Reinhart
421.text: "If you really think anyone will support Rizia, you are living in a land of fantasy, Your Majesty."

424.speaker: Axel Reinhart
424.text: "And what if the investigations reveal actions that cannot simply be rectified? What if they expose a deeper plot or intention?"

425.speaker: Player_Romus
425.text: "Neutral is a strong word, Your Grace. The international community too have their biases."

426.speaker: Player_Romus
426.text: "Exactly. Whatever the findings, we shall abide by them and take the necessary steps to rectify any wrongs and restore peace."

427.speaker: Axel Reinhart
427.text: "And what if the investigations reveal actions that cannot simply be rectified? What if they expose a deeper plot or intention?"

428.speaker: Axel Reinhart
428.text: "There is no other way to resolve this without the presence of a third party, Your Majesty."

429.speaker: Player_Romus
429.text: "Then we face those revelations together and act in the interests of peace and justice. It is a risk, but one I believe we must take for the greater good of our people."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "If our expectations from the start are like this, how do we resolve this issue? If both sides want peace, why would any result change anything?"

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "Then we will act accordingly, Your Grace."

432.speaker: Axel Reinhart
432.text: "First of all, you will release our ships and our sailors immediately."

436.speaker: Axel Reinhart
436.text: "Needless to say, your navy will never be deployed back to Aureus again."

437.speaker: Axel Reinhart
437.text: "And you will pay reparations for the ship you sank, as well as the sailors who lost their lives."

438.speaker: Axel Reinhart
438.text: "To ensure that, we will proceed with our previously agreed-upon deal. You will officially give up your claim to the gas field."

442.speaker: Axel Reinhart
442.text: "To ensure that, you will cede half of the rights you obtained to us."

448.speaker: Axel Reinhart
448.text: "What do we about it then, Your Majesty?"

449.speaker: Player_Romus
449.text: "This disparity in reports is precisely why a joint investigation is critical. We cannot rely solely on biased perspectives."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "Look, Your Grace. I think there's someone else behind this incident. We can't point the fingers at ourselves, we must work together."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "This seems like a plan to sabotage our rights on the Aureus. We made a deal, Duke Reinhart and regardless of what happened, you cannot back away from it."

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "I'm just saying it could be anyone. We simply cannot jump to conclusions."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "We cannot rule out Pales, Your Grace. I don't think I trust your words."

459.speaker: Axel Reinhart
459.text: "So you accept to conduct joint investigations together with international partners or not?"

461.speaker: Player_Romus
461.text: "No. I don't see a point in it anymore."

467.speaker: Player_Romus
467.text: "I'm sorry but I don't support this. There are other powers at play and I cannot hand them the keys."

469.speaker: Axel Reinhart

549.speaker: Player_Romus

551.speaker: Player_Romus
551.text: "There will be no more working together. Let that be clear."

554.speaker: Axel Reinhart
554.text: "You have forced my hand, Your Majesty."

555.speaker: Axel Reinhart

556.speaker: Player_Romus
556.text: "Well... Thank you for the meeting nonetheless."

558.speaker: Player_Romus

559.speaker: Narrator
559.text: He looked at me with skepticism.

561.speaker: Axel Reinhart
561.text: "I'm sorry you came all the way here for this."

562.speaker: Axel Reinhart
562.text: "I understand this was a difficult decision to make."

563.speaker: Axel Reinhart
563.text: "But perhaps we can still work together in the future."

564.speaker: Narrator

567.speaker: Axel Reinhart
567.text: "Well, then. Have a nice day, Your Majesty."

568.speaker: Player_Romus
568.text: "Despite everything, Rizia is ready for that, Your Grace. You can count on us."

570.speaker: Axel Reinhart
570.text: "At least we have reached some level of understanding."

571.speaker: Narrator

572.speaker: Axel Reinhart
572.text: "Thank you for coming to Pales, Your Majesty."

573.speaker: Axel Reinhart
573.text: "Really? You would do that for Pales?"

574.speaker: Axel Reinhart
574.text: "If you cede the field to us officially, not only the incident can be put behind us but I would be indebted to you."

575.speaker: Player_Romus

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "If you don't pull your ships back from the field... War it is, Your Grace."

577.text: A sudden spasm of fear took hold of his face.

590.speaker: Axel Reinhart
590.text: "Needless to say, Vina will be returned to Rizia -- without a scratch on her, by the way. But of course, your navy will never be deployed back to Aureus again."

594.speaker: Axel Reinhart

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "If you do anything to Vina, Pales will cease to exist, Your Grace. I promise you that."

602.speaker: Player_Romus

603.speaker: Axel Reinhart
603.text: "If you make the deal official, we can still work together."

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "No. I won't sign that deal. But you have to let Vina go. Otherwise it will be war."

605.speaker: Player_Romus
605.text: "Listen. I suspect this was fabricated by another player in our region. We should be working together instead of suspecting each other."

606.speaker: Axel Reinhart
606.text: "Then your deal is off the table, Your Majesty."

607.speaker: Axel Reinhart
607.text: "If Rizia can't be a trustable partner, I will not sign the papers -- and you will not be able to extract anything from Aureus."

608.speaker: Axel Reinhart
608.text: "I hope you are not claiming we had a hand in this."

609.speaker: Axel Reinhart

612.speaker: Player_Romus
612.text: "Look, Your Grace. I think there's someone else behind this incident. We can't point the fingers at ourselves, we must work together."

613.speaker: Player_Romus
613.text: "We cannot rely solely on biased perspectives, Your Grace. We should investigate this incident thoroughly before taking any drastic actions."

615.speaker: Axel Reinhart
615.text: "Well... If you're not offering any solution out of this mess, I will back off from the deal."

617.speaker: Axel Reinhart
617.text: "We will make it official soon, Your Majesty. I will invite you to Pales again for the final steps."

618.speaker: Axel Reinhart
618.text: "I hope no more incidents will take place before then."

620.speaker: Player_Romus
620.text: "The responsibility falls on both of our shoulders."

623.speaker: Axel Reinhart

690.text: "Good. You'd better not break your promise."

695.speaker: Narrator
695.text: The Duke waved his hand. The door opened, and I saw Vina waiting for me outside by the exit.

696.speaker: Axel Reinhart
696.text: "We do not take hostages here, Your Majesty."

697.speaker: Narrator
697.text: He smiled as my daughter rushed to embrace me.

698.speaker: Axel Reinhart
698.text: "Oh, by the way... Miss Toras will be staying with us until the investigations are complete."

699.speaker: Axel Reinhart
699.text: "You are making the same mistakes are your father, it seems."
699.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false)

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "I'm not going to play into your hand. Rizia is not going to be forced to offer anything."

710.speaker: Axel Reinhart
710.text: "Why would Morellans be behind this, Your Majesty?"

711.speaker: Axel Reinhart
711.text: "Their influence and presence is all too weak to orchestrate something of this scale without alerting our security."

713.speaker: Axel Reinhart
713.text: "Isn't she the one who's fuelling Rizia's political ambitions in Southern Merkopa?"

714.speaker: Axel Reinhart
714.text: "Are you claiming she wanted to stop Rizia from getting access to more gas -- despite being Rizia's largest energy partner?"

718.speaker: Axel Reinhart
718.text: "Yes... Valgsland has ambitions in these regions. But they don't have any reason to sabotage this deal."

720.speaker: Player_Romus
720.text: "Our relationship has soured of late. I suspect my sister-in-law is trying to hassle us."
720.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false)

721.speaker: Player_Romus
721.text: "The amount of gas we'll gain from Aureus will have other nations begging at our feet. Queen Beatrice would never stand for it."

722.speaker: Player_Romus
722.text: "She is counting on Rizia to annex Pales and become more powerful -- and thus of more use to her."

724.speaker: Axel Reinhart
724.text: "There are no reports or traces of any Rumburgian activity. If you cannot show me any proof -- this will only sound like a conspiracy theory."

725.speaker: Player_Romus
725.text: "You are underestimating their new government. Prime Minister Saltana is a troublesome woman. She wants our monarchies gone."

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "They are commies, Axel. You know what they are capable of."

727.speaker: Player_Romus
727.text: "We are fighting against Saltana's nationalization of the Meftiem International Trade Zone. This is her way of incapacitating us."

729.speaker: Axel Reinhart
729.text: "There are no reports or traces of any Morellan activity. If you cannot show me any proof -- this will only sound like a conspiracy theory."

730.speaker: Player_Romus
730.text: "You know they will come to reclaim Pales sooner or later, Your Grace. That's why they want to keep the field in your hands for now."

731.speaker: Player_Romus
731.text: "They are commies, Axel. You know what they are capable of."

732.speaker: Player_Romus
732.text: "We are a threat in their eyes. Valgsland doesn't want our countries to be close."

733.speaker: Axel Reinhart
733.text: "And I want a neutral investigation by the international community to be conducted. We will wait for the results before finalizing the deal."

734.speaker: Axel Reinhart
734.text: "I want Rizia to pay reparations for the incident."

737.speaker: Player_Romus
737.text: "There's no way I can accept this. If you back away from our deal like this, you will be throwing everything you had with Rizia away."

743.speaker: Axel Reinhart
743.text: "I want a neutral investigation by the international community to be conducted. We will wait for the results before finalizing the deal."

748.speaker: Axel Reinhart
748.text: "You will be responsible for all of the lives that will be lost."

749.speaker: Narrator
749.text: He quickly got up and gestured at the door.

751.speaker: Axel Reinhart
751.text: "Goodbye, Romus. I'll take good care of your daughter until the war is over."

752.speaker: Narrator
752.text: His security quickly ushered me outside.

753.speaker: Player_Romus
753.text: "I offered you a chance for peace, Axel. But you are standing in my way."

755.speaker: Player_Romus
755.text: "Don't worry. We will make it quick."

756.speaker: Narrator
756.text: I walked through the hall with quick steps -- images of war and horror appearing in my head.

757.speaker: Narrator
757.text: Laurento was waiting for me outside with a concerned look on his face.

758.speaker: Narrator
758.text: I tried to tell him about what happened with as few words as possible.

763.speaker: Axel Reinhart
763.text: "To ensure that, you will sign an official concession acknowledging the AN arbitration results and Pales' full ownership of the gas field."

764.speaker: Axel Reinhart
764.text: "Don't mock me, Your Majesty. Consider your offer rejected."

768.speaker: Narrator
768.text: As Laurento, Vina and I left the castle, my daughter was the only one who wasn't smiling.

769.speaker: Narrator
769.text: I took one last look back as I went outside to rejoin Laurento and tell him what I'd agreed to.

776.speaker: Axel Reinhart
776.text: "Lespia is our biggest partner. And you've been long despising the assistance they've given us."

778.speaker: Axel Reinhart
778.text: "There are no reports or traces of any Valgish activity. If you cannot show me any proof -- this will only sound like a conspiracy theory."

780.speaker: Player_Romus
780.text: "I know her well and I don't trust her one bit. I suspect my sister-in-law is trying to hassle us."

781.speaker: Player_Romus
781.text: "We are a threat in their eyes. Morella doesn't want our countries to be close."

782.speaker: Player_Romus
782.text: "Just think about it, Axel. It just makes sense."

784.speaker: Player_Romus
784.text: "What else do you want? That's enough proof of their meddling."

786.speaker: Axel Reinhart
786.text: "I am much more convinced that we need this neutral investigation. I don't see any other path forward."

787.speaker: Axel Reinhart
787.text: "So do you accept to conduct joint investigations together with international partners or not?"

789.speaker: Player_Romus
789.text: "And they have been pushing over the control of Aureus through a deal with you. Haven't they?"

790.speaker: Player_Romus
790.text: "That is precisely the point. They want you to stay reliant on them and having a separate deal with us surely didn't make them happy."

791.speaker: Player_Romus
791.text: "We are a threat in their eyes. Lespia doesn't want our countries to be close. You know that."

792.speaker: Player_Romus
792.text: "They are the direct agents of ATO in all Eastern Merkopa. This is their plan to dismantle our monarchies from within."

793.speaker: Axel Reinhart
793.text: "Mr. Alvarez is surely mad about our deal to sell the rights to Rizia instead, but do you really think he'd go that far..."

794.speaker: Player_Romus
794.text: "Why wouldn't he? He has both the means and the goals to sabotage our deal. And he is succeeding with every second we suspect each other."

795.speaker: Player_Romus
795.text: "Who else, Your Grace? Rizia is surely not behind this as we've already paid our sum for the rights. And this happens right before it's finalized. The only loser of this deal is Lespia."

796.speaker: Player_Romus
796.text: "They are puppets of the game Arcasia is playing in our region. You know how far they can go, Axel."

802.speaker: Axel Reinhart
802.text: "I don't know, Your Majesty. I won't be convinced like this."

803.speaker: Axel Reinhart
803.text: "We have to look into this together."

804.speaker: Narrator
804.text: He stopped for a moment to think.

805.speaker: Axel Reinhart
805.text: "However, if you really want us to continue with this deal, I expect you to acknowledge the Rizian mistakes that led to this incident."

806.speaker: Axel Reinhart
806.text: "My people will expect something from your side. If we're to be going this route together, I expect you to pay reparations for the violent exchange."

810.speaker: Axel Reinhart
810.text: "I only ask of a modest sum. As a symbolic gesture."

812.speaker: Player_Romus
812.text: "No, Your Grace. Absolutely out of the question."

813.speaker: Axel Reinhart
813.text: "You have to pay for the Palesian lives that were killed by the Rizian Army."

818.speaker: Axel Reinhart
818.text: "Great. Then I believe I can make our signing work on our previously agreed-upon date."

845.speaker: Player_Romus
845.text: "Peace is too expensive for our kingdom, Duke."
